Ying Ying and Martin are lovely couples and fabulous hosts. They are really welcoming their guests. I really enjoyed staying with them for a month. The room was very quiet and private, and I could sleep well. 
The location is also great. It's my first Airbnb deal and it was great. I highly recommend here.
